what_happened: Scene layout/style 10: single basin, stem faucet with horizontal spout arm and side lever (as s7, s29). Stage 0 fast: lever 107-152 (close at 100), water at 140. Stage 1: 200-300 the arm swung out right and back, the wrist looking down into the sink at the stream. 359-370 the gripper touched the spout and pushed it only to +0.21 (still 'centre'). From ~400 it wandered: the arm reared up (500), swung over to the LEFT of the faucet above the plate (540-608, wrist on the window and backsplash), then swept back right across the faucet 628-668, its forearm (no gripper contact recorded) knocking the spout to +0.62 (right washed 644), and 700-900 stayed right of the sink with the wrist on a canister on the counter, then at the faucet with the stream in view. No contact pushed the spout left (min -0.06).
causal_chain: weak first spout push (+0.21, 359-370) -> 500 steps of large arm excursions away from the spout (400-900) -> right credited only by an arm sweep at 644 -> left never washed
official_criterion_notes: The spout moved +0.21 -> +0.62 at 628-648 with no gripper_touch interval in the packet: the contact was by an arm link, which the packet's gripper-only touch intervals do not record.

packet_facts: spout angle from saved states (run/<tag>_steps.npz, column validated against packet washed_loc/spout_ori); 'left' needs <= -0.524 rad, 'right' >= +0.524: +0.21 from 372 to 628, +0.62 from 648, min -0.06

uncertain_about: The purpose of the 500-608 excursion to the left of the faucet; it never contacted the spout from that side.
